verses.english: “When a foolish, incompetent untrue person has three qualities they keep themselves broken and damaged. …

verses.pali: visamena kāyakammena, visamena vacīkammena, visamena manokammena …pe….
verses.english: Unethical deeds by way of body, speech, and mind. …
When an astute, competent true person has three qualities they keep themselves intact and unscathed. …

verses.pali: samena kāyakammena, samena vacīkammena, samena manokammena …pe….
verses.english: Ethical deeds by way of body, speech, and mind. …”
